description: hydrobr is a Python package for selecting, retrieving and cleaning hydrological observations from Brazil's National Water Agency. Its README describes pluvio- and fluviometric station data, filtering and quality checks for use in local studies. Users choose stations and periods; outputs are organised rainfall and river-flow series. Geographic coverage is Brazil's ANA network. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the package. The authors call the published version beta and say it was tested in only a few basins; users should cross-check processed observations against official ANA records. A limitation is that gaps and changes in station equipment can bias a catchment simulation even after automated cleaning. hydrobr can prepare forcing and calibration series for reservoirs, flood models and water-supply planning. The related catalogue ERA5 reanalysis is a separate gridded weather source. No ANA measurements or package was downloaded.
